description: Wire up the email verification flow in Better Auth configuration and add invitation email sending to the workspace.invite.send handler. This connects the new templates from FEAT-001 to actual send points in the application. Also wire low-balance alert email into the billing autoreload check and payment-failed email into the dunning onInvoicePaymentFailed handler.
steps: Modify packages/auth/src/auth.ts - Add a top-level `emailVerification` config block to the betterAuth() call with `sendVerificationEmail` callback and `sendOnSignIn: true`. Import the new emailVerificationTemplate from @oxagen/notifications. The callback should use the fire-and-forget pattern (void sendEmail({...})) matching the existing sendResetPassword pattern. Also add `requireEmailVerification: true` to the emailAndPassword config block.

Update packages/auth/src/auth.config.test.ts - Add a new describe block 'email verification config invariants' that tests: (1) requireEmailVerification is true, (2) sendVerificationEmail is a function, (3) callback does not throw when invoked. Follow the same pattern as the existing 'sendResetPassword config invariants' test block.

Modify packages/handlers/src/workspace.invite.send.ts - After the invitation row is created/returned, send an invitation email to input.email using sendEmail() with invitationEmailTemplate(). Import sendEmail and invitationEmailTemplate from @oxagen/notifications. Resolve the inviter's name from the DB (query users table for ctx.userId to get displayName). Resolve the org name (query organizations table for ctx.orgId). Construct the inviteUrl as `${process.env.APP_URL || 'https://oxagen-v2-app.vercel.app'}/invitations/${row.publicId}`. Use fire-and-forget (void sendEmail(...)) so the handler still returns immediately. The orgName lookup and email send should be wrapped in a try-catch that logs errors but does not fail the handler.

Modify packages/billing/src/dunning.ts - In the onInvoicePaymentFailed function, after successfully updating the dunning state to 'grace', send a payment-failed email to org managers. Import notifyOrgManagers and paymentFailedTemplate from @oxagen/notifications. Call notifyOrgManagers with kind:'system', the rendered paymentFailedTemplate HTML, and a deepLink to the billing page. Wrap in try-catch (fire-and-forget, log errors). The billingUrl should be `${process.env.APP_URL || 'https://oxagen-v2-app.vercel.app'}/${orgSlug}/settings/billing` - but since we don't have orgSlug here, use a generic `/settings/billing` deep link path.

Modify packages/billing/src/autoreload.ts - In the isLowBalance function (or create a new exported function sendLowBalanceAlert), after detecting low balance, provide a hook point for sending the low balance alert. Actually, the better approach: create a new exported async function `notifyLowBalance(orgId: string, result: LowBalanceResult)` that sends the low-balance email via notifyOrgManagers with lowBalanceAlertTemplate. Import notifyOrgManagers and lowBalanceAlertTemplate from @oxagen/notifications. The topUpUrl should be a relative deep link. Wrap the notification in try-catch (never fail billing operations due to notification failure).
acceptance_criteria: packages/auth/src/auth.ts contains emailVerification.sendVerificationEmail callback that calls sendEmail with emailVerificationTemplate
packages/auth/src/auth.ts has requireEmailVerification: true in emailAndPassword config
packages/handlers/src/workspace.invite.send.ts sends invitation email after creating the invitation row
packages/billing/src/dunning.ts sends payment-failed notification to org managers when entering grace state
packages/billing/src/autoreload.ts exports notifyLowBalance function that sends low-balance alert via notifyOrgManagers
All email sends use fire-and-forget pattern (void or try-catch) and never break the parent operation
TypeScript compilation passes for all modified packages
